meeting_scene: As the team gathered around the conference table, Sam shifted uncomfortably in his seat, his 95% morale rate reflected on a sea of confident faces. Priya spoke up first, her voice smooth as silk as she mentioned an upcoming project deadline - "Hey everyone, just wanted to touch base with you all about our Smith account; we need it wrapped by next Thursday." The room hummed in response before Alex contributed their own thought process: thinking out loud, they discussed potential strategies for tackling the challenge ahead. Jordan's eyes widened as Priya named-checks a key stakeholder - "Sounds good to me if that means we're getting John on board; he can open doors I don't think anyone else could." As Riya quietly chimed in with her own thoughts, Sam slipped back into quiet mode once more.
